selection_rationale: Fastest baseline, but 8x upsampling over-smooths fine boundaries, missing small lesions.
Optimal Pareto frontier: Top-tier Dice/IoU accuracy with ~48% fewer parameters than ResUNet and fast ~214ms CPU inference, ideal for lightweight cloud deployment.
Deep residual representations improve gradient flow, but 92% more parameters with high CPU latency (~401 ms).
Attention gates highlight salient tumor regions, but add substantial computational latency on CPU (~337 ms).
